record_title: Weak off-diagonal necessity for monomial-curve commutators in every dimension
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: Restricted to 1<p<=q<infinity and monomial curves. The result does not enlarge the known strong-sufficiency region, and it does not address q<p, endpoints, compactness/VMO, weighted commutators, or general polynomial curves. The higher-dimensional geometry is inherited from Li--Zeng's companion-rectangle construction. Recency leaves residual risk of unindexed simultaneous work.
